name: Case file row links the download and shows the start of its SHA-256
description: Validates the case file row in Evidence mode: it links /cases/eagle-s-2024/case-file as a download named cabletrace-eagle-s-2024.json, and the 12 characters it shows are the start of the full SHA-256 in its tooltip. The downloaded file itself is checked by testsprite/backend/case_file_checksum.py, which recomputes the hash.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?mode=evidence and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the "Case file" row (data-testid download-case-file) is a link with href "/cases/eagle-s-2024/case-file" and a download attribute "cabletrace-eagle-s-2024.json"
Assert the row shows a 12 character lowercase hexadecimal hash, and that element's title attribute reads "SHA-256 " followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters that start with the 12 shown
Assert the row reads "Case file" and "JSON with every position, quote and source"
